description: This Java interface defines a repository for AI model entities, providing methods for querying, counting, and deleting AI models in a SQL database, with custom queries for search and deletion operations.
external_methods: Page<AiModelEntity> findByTenantId(UUID tenantId, String textSearch, Pageable pageable)

classes.name: AiModelRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for AI model entities, extending JpaRepository and providing custom query methods for AI model management.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Finds an AI model by tenant ID and model ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an AI model by tenant ID and model name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of AI models matching tenant ID and optional text search.

methods.name: findIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of AI model IDs for a given tenant.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Gets the external ID associated with a specific AI model ID.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts the number of AI models for a specific tenant.

methods.name: deleteByIdIn
methods.description: Deletes AI models by a set of IDs.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all AI models associated with a tenant ID.

methods.name: deleteByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Deletes specific AI models for a tenant based on a set of IDs.

calls: Page<AiModelEntity> findByTenantId(UUID tenantId, String textSearch, Pageable pageable)
